exercises.notes: Set the bench near thirty degrees and let the dumbbells travel slightly wider than a flat press so the clavicular fibres take the work.
Set the seat height so the handles sit at mid-chest and your elbows track just under shoulder height.
Set the seat so the handles line up with your upper chest, not your collarbone, and drive straight out along that line.
Stand tall with the cable behind your back so tension holds through the bottom of every rep.
Keep a soft elbow and raise slightly in front of your body rather than straight out to the side.
Fix the elbows against your sides and let only the forearms move through the rep.

muscleGroups: Upper Chest, Chest, Lateral Deltoids, Triceps
notes: Push session with chest emphasis — simulation rationale for chest. Baseline week: establish repeatable technique and progression anchors. Warm-up: 3-5 min light cardio, band pull-aparts and pec stretch, then 2-3 progressive ramp sets into Incline Dumbbell Press. Prep: rotator cuff activation between warm-up sets

exercises.notes: Keep the spine neutral and push the hips back rather than bending at the waist.
Keep the lower back flat against the pad through the whole range.
Keep the front shin roughly vertical and the torso tall.
Keep the back against the pad and extend without kicking the weight up.
Keep the hips pinned to the pad so the movement stays at the knee.
Take a full stretch at the bottom and a hard pause at the top of every rep.
Move slowly and keep the ribs pulled toward the hips throughout.

notes: Lower session with quads emphasis — simulation rationale for quads. Baseline week: establish repeatable technique and progression anchors. Warm-up: 5-7 min bike or incline walk, hip flexor stretch and ankle dorsiflexion drills, then 2-3 progressive ramp sets into Barbell Romanian Deadlift.
Active recovery, mobility work, and light cardio.

exercises.notes: Keep your shoulder blades pinned to the bench and touch the bar high on the chest, just under the collarbone.
Keep a fixed soft bend in the elbow and open only at the shoulder.
Initiate each rep by setting the scapula, then pull with the elbows.
Keep the chest supported and lead with the elbows so the rear delts carry the movement.
Stop when the arms reach the torso line rather than driving them behind it.
Fix the elbows against your sides and let only the forearms move through the rep.
Move slowly and keep the ribs pulled toward the hips throughout.

muscleGroups: Upper Chest, Chest, Upper Back, Rear Deltoids
notes: Upper session with chest emphasis — simulation rationale for chest. Baseline week: establish repeatable technique and progression anchors. Warm-up: 3-5 min light cardio, band pull-aparts and pec stretch, lat stretch and scapular setting drills, then 2-3 progressive ramp sets into Incline Barbell Press. Prep: rotator cuff activation between warm-up sets
Active recovery, mobility work, and light cardio.

exercises.notes: Start from a full hang with the shoulders pulled down, then lead with the elbows rather than the chin.
Let the shoulders rise slightly at the top of each rep, then pull them down first and follow with the elbows.
Set the shoulder blade before the elbow moves, and let the handle come to your waist rather than your ribs.
Keep the elbows fixed and the torso still so nothing swings into the rep.
Keep the elbows just in front of your ribs and stop the upswing before the forearms reach vertical.
